lines.zh: 风往哪边吹，我就往哪走。
lines.en: I walk whichever way the wind blows.
The wind holds me; I still fly unsteady.
The wind pushes me; I do not strain.
The wind pushes me. My feet need no effort.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一张，风就先动。
lines.en: My wings open and the wind moves first.
Every step of mine spins the wind around.
The wind's too strong. My feet won't hold.

lines.zh: 别踩我的影子，风会把你推开。
lines.en: Don't step on my shadow, the wind will shove you.

lines.zh: 我踩过的草，都朝一边倒。
lines.en: The grass I tread bends all to one side.

lines.zh: 风把叶子吹得满天，路都看不见。
lines.en: Wind fills the air with leaves. I can't see the path.
While the wind stays warm, I head back.
One lift of my wings and the wind shoves me.
This clump of grass has been pressed flat by wind.
The wind carries me, unsteadily.
The wind circles at my feet.
The wind drags the clouds low. Pretty.
My wings cannot hold the wind yet.
The wind keeps whistling, like someone calling.
Wind slips between my feathers. Ticklish.

lines.zh: 有风托着，我就不用使劲。
lines.en: With wind beneath me, I don't have to try.
The wind smells of green grass.
Time to fly? A little longer.
Wind slips between my feathers.
The wind pushed a cloud away.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我这小身板就飘。
lines.en: One gust and this small body floats.

lines.zh: 我在等一阵能托起我的风。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a wind that can lift me.
Wings spread, waiting for wind.
Grass seed on the wind, and I'm hungry.
I'm still. The wind is moving.
One little gust and I tip over.
The wind stops, and so do I.
Lying in the grass, waiting for a strong gust.

lines.zh: 你站远些，风会绕你一圈。
lines.en: Stand back. The wind circles you.

lines.zh: 我一抬头，风就把我吹偏。
lines.en: I look up, and the wind blows me off balance.

lines.zh: 你走路带风，我一听就知道。
lines.en: You walk with wind in your step. I know it.
The wind has messed up your hair.
The wind blew me right to you.
One gust and my down goes everywhere.
Under that hat there seems to be wind.
The wind holds me, but unsteadily.
The wind never brought your scent before.

lines.zh: 你手里的草，被风吹歪了。
lines.en: The grass in your hand bends in the wind.
There's a scent on the wind. Is it yours?
Don't touch my wings. The wind bites.

lines.zh: 风还没学会，先学会瞪人。
lines.en: I can't fly yet. I can glare.
I can't feel the wind. That's bad.
The wind shifted and I flipped over.

lines.zh: 风把我掀翻，我记住这力道。
lines.en: The wind flipped me. I'll remember that force.
When the wind stops, I drop.
I chirped once, and the wind scattered.

lines.zh: 羽毛根根立起，像被风吹的。
lines.en: Every feather stands up, as if wind-blown.
You hit me so hard my wingtips quiver.
When the wind stops, I drop.
Let me land. My wing joints are too soft.

lines.zh: 风把香味送到我鼻尖了。
lines.en: The wind carried that smell to my beak.
Grass seed on the wind; I followed it.
Hold it higher, so the wind carries it to me.
One gust and I drift up.

lines.zh: 你手里的草，被风绕住了。
lines.en: The grass in your hand is caught in the wind.

lines.zh: 风里那点甜味，我张嘴接住。
lines.en: That sweetness in the wind; I open my beak to catch it.

lines.zh: 我翅膀短，借不到那股风。
lines.en: My wings are short. I can't catch that gust.
Better than wind-blown seeds.
One push of wind and I drift away.

lines.zh: 这草籽味，我跟着风来的。
lines.en: That seed smell — I followed the wind here.

lines.zh: 风把香味吹到我这儿了。
lines.en: The wind brought that smell to me.
If the wind stops, the smell is gone.

lines.zh: 为这一株，我跑得比风快。
lines.en: For this shoot I'd outrun the wind.
May I have one more shoot?
Sweetness on the wind. I smell it.

lines.zh: 上次那阵风，也带着这味。
lines.en: Last time the wind carried this same smell.

lines.zh: 下次绕开风走，我翅膀轻。
lines.en: Go around the wind; my wings are light.
A wind phoenix chick that can't fly yet.
I'm light. One shove tips me over.

lines.zh: 我这翅膀，还没学会借风。
lines.en: These wings haven't learned to borrow the wind.

lines.zh: 翅膀撞折一根，风就漏了。
lines.en: One wing bent, and now the wind leaks through.
Make way, the wind pushes me along.
The wind pushed me into you. Sorry.
Knocked askew — I'll lean on the wind to straighten up.

lines.zh: 你带起的风，把我掀翻了。
lines.en: The wind off you knocked me over.
One spread of my wings fills the path.

lines.zh: 我们的崽，会生来就带风。
lines.en: Our chick will be born with wind in it.
My scent rides the wind; don't follow.

lines.zh: 一个翅膀拍左边，一个拍右边。
lines.en: One wing beats left, one beats right.

lines.zh: 头靠头，让风也羡慕我们。
lines.en: Head to head, and let the wind envy us.

lines.zh: 最嫩的芽，被我用风盖住了。
lines.en: The tenderest shoot — I covered it with wind.

lines.zh: 你的翅尖，比我更会切风。
lines.en: Your wingtips cut the wind better than mine.

lines.zh: 风里你的味道，我记了四季。
lines.en: Your scent on the wind — I've kept it four seasons.
I guard this wind, and you as well.
The wind holds me up — do not let go.

lines.zh: 风绕着咱俩转，停不下来。
lines.en: The wind circles us and won't settle.
Light enough for the wind to take — hold it tight.
This thing smells like ash.
One flap of my small wings bends the grass.
This is light; I can carry it.

lines.zh: 风一吹它响，我就叼回来。
lines.en: It rings in the wind, so I carried it back.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进绒毛里，风吹不走。
lines.en: I tuck it into my down where wind cannot take it.

lines.zh: 气味像灰，风一吹就散了。
lines.en: It smells like ash. One gust and it's gone.
Lighter than a seed. The wind can carry it.
The wind blew it to me.
My beak is free right now; give it here.
You've broken my air current.

lines.zh: 风刃还没长成，先试一下。
lines.en: My wind blade isn't grown. Let's test it.

lines.zh: 我这小身子，风托得起来。
lines.en: This small body is lifted by the wind.
I have not learned to turn with the wind.
My wings haven't filled out.

lines.zh: 你踩到气流的那条线了。
lines.en: You stepped on the line of my airstream.
Small wings can't lift me. Wait.
The wind shifts, and I have you.
Come close and taste a wind blade.
Who flattened that patch of grass?

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的风还没长成。
lines.en: The wind in my wings isn't grown yet.

lines.zh: 草倒的方向，告诉我你往哪跑。
lines.en: The bent grass tells me which way you ran.

lines.zh: 我翅膀下的风，跑得比你快。
lines.en: The wind under my wings runs faster than you.
Wind under my claws — no brakes.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一扇，草都倒向一边。
lines.en: One flap and the grass bends aside.
I turn with the wind — faster than you.

lines.zh: 风把你的味道送到我这儿。
lines.en: The wind brought your scent to me.
One wingbeat and the wind turns.

lines.zh: 追完你，我要落在草地上。
lines.en: After this I'll land in the grass.
Heard that flutter of wings?
One flap of my wing, and the wind shoves you.

lines.zh: 幼小的我，也能把风扯成旋。
lines.en: Even young, I twist wind into a spiral.
My wings are still soft.
My beak is harder than the wind.

lines.zh: 风凤凰的幼羽，也会刮人。
lines.en: Even a young wind phoenix's feathers can cut.
The wind hasn't settled. Again.
Step back and I'll stop flapping.
My wings can't stir the wind yet.

lines.zh: 这一翅，替我整群风凤凰。
lines.en: This wingbeat is for my whole flock.
After this fight, even the wind is tired.
Morning wind carries seed. I'll eat first.
Huh? How did I get here?
The wind turned, and I woke.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛被吹得满满鼓起。
lines.en: The wind has filled and puffed out my down.
The wind comes from there. Noted.
My first breath is a gust of wind.
The wind comes off the treetops, smelling of leaves.
My first gust of wind made me cough.
I drifted in the wind all night.
The wind holds me, and I try to stand straight.
Fire burns, and my wind goes wild.
The wind missed me, and I dropped into the grass.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀湿了，飞不起来。
lines.en: My wings are wet. I can't fly.
The blast flung me high.

lines.zh: 风吹歪了第一支，第二支没歪。
lines.en: The wind bent the first arrow, not the second.
The spell jumbled the wind holding me up.
The wind holds me up, but my belly is empty.

lines.zh: 雷把我的羽毛电得根根立起。
lines.en: The lightning leaves every feather standing.
No wind below to hold me.
